results.title: Inland Rail
results.description:
Inland Rail - Public Facing Alignment prepared for the Department of Infrastructure 26 June2023

The alignment layer is currently utilized on a temporary basis and is not intended for external distribution.

This version fixes minor corrections in N2N (removal of small incorrect legacy lines) and supersedes ver 20230517

C2K (Calvert to Kagaru) - New track within existing corridor, New corridor and Tunnel

H2C (Helidon to Calvert) - New track within existing corridor, New corridor and Tunnel

G2H(Gowrie to Helidon)- New track within existing corridor, New corridor and Tunnel

B2G (NSW/QLD Border to Gowrie) - New track within existing corridor and New corridor

NS2B (Narrabri to North Star) - Upgrade track within existing corridorand New corridor(Newell Highway)

N2NS (Narrabri to North Star) - Upgrade track within existing corridor

N2N (Narromine to Narrabri) - New Corridor

P2N (Parkes to Narromine) - Upgrade track within existing corridor

S2P (Stockinbingal to Parkes) - Upgrade track within existing corridor

I2S (Illabo to Stockinbingal) - New corridor

A2I (Albury to Illabo) - Upgrade track within existing corridor

B2A(Beveridgeto Albury) - Upgrade track within existing corridor

results.title: Hosting Capacity – LOAD (Hex)
results.description:
This map/dashboard provides a high-level view of firm hosting capacity across the distribution network for planning and triage.

Data inputs:
• Substation locations and transformer ratings (kVA)
• Hosting capacity outputs (Firm_Spare_Capacity_kW, Best_Case_Spare_Capacity_kW, constraints) from the Databricks pipeline (latest run)

Map behaviour:
• Hex view (vector tiles): display bands align to coloured maps:
 – 1 m–18 m = 15 km
 – 150 k–1 m = 5 km
 – 0–150 k  = 1 km (persists to full zoom)
• Substation view: pop-ups show Spare (kW), Transformer rating (kVA), Spare (%), Capacity type
• “No data” (grey) where inputs are null/zero
• Labels persist further out for readability

Use:
• Intended for strategic planning and triage only
• Detailed assessment remains via approved planning tools
• Outputs reflect the state of the model at time of execution and do not account for subsequent committed works
results.snippet: Strategic view of firm hosting capacity for distribution substations. Hex/point views support planning and triage; detailed assessment remains via approved planning tools. Bands: 1 m–18 m (15 km), 150 k–1 m (5 km), 0–150 k (1 km).
results.licenseInfo: Internal planning and triage use only. Not for customer connection approval or public release. No warranty; verify against current committed works.
